2137-3480-4642.description:
Cast Awaken the Woods with X equal to 3 by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands you control to their owner's hand, copying Awaken the Woods.
Resolve the copy of Awaken the Woods, creating three 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature tokens.
Activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.
2137-3480-4642.notes: Once you have infinite green mana and infinite land tokens, you may activate Uyo any number of times, targeting any number of instant or sorcery spells.

1479-2841-6754-8099.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Prismatic Vista.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-6754-8099.description:
Fetch a land using Prismatic Vista.
When the fetched land enters, Eusocial Engineering and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Eusocial Engineering trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Eusocial Engineering from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Eusocial Engineering triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2034-6854--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2034-6854--5--195.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it, adding {C}{C}.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Host of the Hereafter trigger.
Resolve Host of the Hereafter's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Repeat.

1479-3147-7892.description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it, Thranduil the Strategist, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil the Strategist trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Thranduil the Strategist trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1742-2921-5003-7848.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four graveyards that each have seven or more cards in them.
1742-2921-5003-7848.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing The Master of Lake-town.
When The Master of Lake-town dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Master of Lake-town trigger, drawing a card for each graveyard that has seven or more cards in it.
Holding priority, activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Repeat step 4 three additional times.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return The Master of Lake-town from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.
1742-2921-5003-7848.notes: If your graveyard has six cards in it, you can count that as one of the graveyards with seven cards in it, as The Master of Lake-town will count as the seventh card.

489-4200-6867-6967.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

549-2685-4186-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
549-2685-4186-6996.description:
Gain life in any way.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1303-1769-5686.description:
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Rot Hulk enters, it and Necroduality trigger.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Rot Hulk.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger, failing to return anything to the battlefield.
Resolve the Necroduality trigger, creating a token copy of Rot Hulk.
When the token Rot Hulk enters, it triggers, returning Rot Hulk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-5003-7689--165.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the other Hero, adding {C}{C}.
When the Hero dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return the Hero from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When the Hero enters, Black Panther triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2334-2724-3217.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Soulherder. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Tocatli Honor Guard.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

457-1409-2829-7306.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Arcbound Ravager leaves and reenters the battlefield, causing it to enter with +1/+1 counters due to its modular ability, and triggering The Ooze and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve Deadeye Navigator's trigger, repairing it and Arcbound Ravager
Resolve The Ooze's trigger, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter that was on Arcbound Ravager when it left the battlefield.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping Arcbound Ravager and a Mutagen, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.
457-1409-2829-7306.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability. The Mutagens can be sacrificed to Arcbound Ravager, allowing you to create additional Mutagens each loop.

856-4321-5231-7396.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-4321-5231-7396.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius, History Chaser trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius, History Chaser trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

698-2060-4415-6930.notablePrerequisites: You've gained 2 or more life this turn.
698-2060-4415-6930.description:
Activate Will by tapping it, causing white and blue spells you cast to cost {1} less for each life you've gained this turn.
Cast Stonecloaker by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Stonecloaker enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1322-2011-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1322-2011-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Najeela as attackers.
Najeela triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
1322-2011-3259.notes: Najeela can make additional Warriors if you attack with multiple each iteration. Najeela doesn't have to attack after the first iteration, as the Warrior token will trigger it.

1414-5660-6701.description:
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to its power on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Lotus Petal from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Lotus Petal by paying {0}.
Repeat.

283-2085-7163.easyPrerequisites: You are able to put a triggered ability on the stack.
283-2085-7163.description:
Put any triggered ability on the stack.
Holding priority, activate Mister Fantastic by paying {R}{G}{W}{U} and tapping it, targeting that ability.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers. Holding priority, activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, untapping Mister Fantastic.
Activate Mister Fantastic by paying {R}{G}{W}{U} and tapping it, copying Illusionist's Bracers' trigger twice
Resolve the first copy of Illusionist Bracers' trigger, copying Mister Fantastic's ability, targeting Illusionist's Bracers' trigger.
Resolve the copy of Mister Fantastic's ability, copying Illusionist's bracers' trigger twice.
Repeat from step 5.

1594-3532-4928-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
1594-3532-4928-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Forgotten Ancient triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

141-5117-5256.description:
Cast Undying Malice by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Undying Malice, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Undying Malice.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Altar of Dementia abilities from step 5.

2034-5220-6535-6900.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Serrated Scorpion.
When Serrated Scorpion dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Serrated Scorpion from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Serrated Scorpion trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Cast Serrated Scorpion from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

277-4693-5721-6883.easyPrerequisites: There are at least six land cards between your graveyard and the battlefield under your control, one of which must be a Swamp, that can collectively tap to produce at least {3}{B}{B}{G}.
277-4693-5721-6883.description:
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing any land, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat step 1 until you have at least six land cards in your graveyard, with one of those cards being a Swamp.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{B}{B}{G}.
Activate Strands of Night by paying {B}{B} and 2 life and sacrificing a Swamp, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aftermath Analyst enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Repeat.

518-5941-6191.notablePrerequisites:
Bloodthirsty Conqueror has indestructible.
You control another indestructible creature.
You have a way to deal damage to Bloodthirsty Conqueror.
518-5941-6191.description:
Cast Arcbond by paying {2}{R}, targeting Bloodthirsty Conqueror.
Holding priority, cast Wild Ricochet by paying its mana cost, copying Arcbond, with the copy targeting another indestructible creature you control.
Resolve both Arcbonds.
Deal damage to Bloodthirsty Conqueror.
Arbond triggers, dealing that much damage to each player and each other creature.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers for each opponent dealt damage, and Arcbond triggers due to the other indestructible creature being dealt damage.
Resolve all Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Arcbond trigger, dealing that much damage to each player and each other creature.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers for each opponent dealt damage, and Arcbond triggers due to Bloodthirsty Conqueror being dealt damage.
Resolve all Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Arcbond trigger, dealing that much damage to each player and each other creature.
Repeat form step 6.

224-2783-5627.notablePrerequisites:
Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
224-2783-5627.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
If the sacrificed creature was a Dragon Egg, it triggers, creating a 2/2 Dragon creature token.
Resolve the Wight of the Reliquary ability, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Nesting Dragon and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.
Repeat.

4821-5803.notablePrerequisites:
Kitsa does not have summoning sickness.
Kitsa has power 2 or greater.
Nonland permanents you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
4821-5803.description:
Cast Dramatic Reversal by paying {1}{U}.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Dramatic Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Dramatic Reversal, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
Repeat from step 3.

242-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Seraph of the Scales, adding {C}{C}.
When Seraph of the Scales dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger,
Resolve the Seraph of the Scales trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Seraph of the Scales from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

2926-3957-4613.notablePrerequisites: Famished Paladin has at least one +1/+1 counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
2926-3957-4613.description:
Activate Famished Paladin using Traveling Minister's ability by tapping it, causing target creature to get +1/+0 until end of turn, and you to gain 1 life.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

1530-2963-3544-5049.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is five or less.
1530-2963-3544-5049.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Second Chance triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and take an extra turh after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Auramancer.
When Auramancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Second Chance from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Second Chance by paying {2}{U}.
Repeat each turn.

1692-2972-3750.notablePrerequisites: Helm of the Host attached to Ganax.
1692-2972-3750.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Ganax with haste.
The Ganax token enters the battlefield, triggering each Ganax you control, creating that many Treasure tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate all Treasure tokens you control by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least {R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

2123-2292-3211-3260-4078-4812.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 18.
Your devotion to black is at least ten or you have at least two opponents.
2123-2292-3211-3260-4078-4812.description:
Cast Buried Alive by paying {2} and two life, searching for Chainer, Viscera Seer, and Kokusho.
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1} and two life.
Animate Dead enters the battlefield, returning Chainer onto the battlefield attached with Animate Dead.
Activate Chainer by paying nine life, returning Viscera Seer from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Nightmare in addition to its other creature types.
Activate Chainer by paying nine life, returning Kokusho from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Nightmare in addition to its other creature types.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Kokusho.
Kokusho dies, causing each opponent to lose 5 life and causing you to gain life equal to the amount of life lost this way.
Resolve the Viscera Seer, scrying 1.
Repeat from step 5.

2281-5237-5256.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Renegade Rallier.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Renegade Rallier.
When Renegade Rallier dies, Saffi triggers, returning Renegade Rallier from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Renegade Rallier enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Renegade Rallier's power.
Repeat.
